# manual capture: FXC on the repro, for issue #3377
# harness:  ce-probe.py   (re-runnable: `python ce-probe.py <compiler-id> <shader> "<args>"`)
# compiler: fxc_10_0_19041 on Compiler Explorer  (Direct3D Shader Compiler 10.1)
# ran:      2026-08-07
# NOTE:     hand-driven capture, not a probe of the primary repro. Not scored by match.json.
#
# WHY
# The issue body opens with "It successfully compiles on FXC as Pixel Shader 5.0, but fails to
# build on DXC as Pixel Shader 6.0". That is a checkable claim about a second compiler, and it
# is the reason a D3D9-era shader was ported this way in the first place. CASE 1 checks it.
#
# CASE 2 and CASE 3 are the controls SKILL.md requires before believing a cross-compiler
# difference. CASE 3 shows FXC on this harness does report failures when there are any
# (exit 1, "error X3501"), so CASE 1's exit 0 is a real success and not the harness swallowing
# an error. CASE 2 shows FXC -- unlike DXC -- does not require a semantic on the parameter
# either, so the difference is about the whole construct, not only about the semantic.
#
# Limits: this is a compile, not an execution; it says FXC accepts the source, not that the
# resulting shader does anything sensible with `decal`.
### CASE 1: repro.hlsl -- the issue body's claim, verbatim
### compiler: fxc_10_0_19041
### source:   repro.hlsl
### args:     /T ps_5_0 /E main_fragment
### exit:     0
[stdout] Microsoft (R) Direct3D Shader Compiler 10.1
[stdout] Copyright (C) 2013 Microsoft. All rights reserved.
[stdout] 
[stdout] compilation code save succeeded; see C:\Windows\TEMP\compiler-explorer-compilerWdEycv\output.s
### CASE 2: control-no-semantic.hlsl -- the same source minus the `: TEXUNIT0` semantic
### compiler: fxc_10_0_19041
### source:   control-no-semantic.hlsl
### args:     /T ps_5_0 /E main_fragment
### exit:     0
[stdout] Microsoft (R) Direct3D Shader Compiler 10.1
[stdout] Copyright (C) 2013 Microsoft. All rights reserved.
[stdout] 
[stdout] compilation code save succeeded; see C:\Windows\TEMP\compiler-explorer-compiler6dVJ3S\output.s
### CASE 3: repro.hlsl with a bogus entry point -- proves this harness reports failures
### compiler: fxc_10_0_19041
### source:   repro.hlsl
### args:     /T ps_5_0 /E no_such_entry
### exit:     1
[stdout] Microsoft (R) Direct3D Shader Compiler 10.1
[stdout] Copyright (C) 2013 Microsoft. All rights reserved.
[stdout] 
[stderr] error X3501: 'no_such_entry': entrypoint not found
[stderr] 
[stderr] compilation failed; no code produced
